red_tests.failure_fingerprint: 13 errors (scripts/commit_msg_trailer.py does not exist) + 1 failed (hook not installed)

rationale: TDD baseline for KAN-179 auto Test-Baseline trailer hook. RED proven: with no helper module the suite produced 13 errors and 1 failure because scripts/commit_msg_trailer.py and .githooks/prepare-commit-msg did not exist. GREEN: 20 passed. Design note: the first implementation keyed the trigger on a STAGED manifest, which unit test test_appends_when_baseline_is_provable caught as wrong -- in the real TDD flow the GREEN/source commit stages only source files because the manifest was committed in the RED step, so a staged-manifest trigger could never fire. The contract was redesigned to key on a COMMITTED manifest whose allowed_source_paths covers the staged source paths, matching the guard's SOURCE_COMMIT_MISSING_BASELINE_TRAILER semantics. An end-to-end commit test additionally exposed that a shared core.hooksPath made the hook a SILENT no-op, because it resolved scripts/commit_msg_trailer.py relative to the invoking repo instead of the hook location; the hook now resolves the repo root explicitly and WARNs when the helper is absent rather than exiting 0 quietly. The .githooks/commit-msg read-only contract is preserved and pinned by test_commit_msg_hook_remains_read_only.
